notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
FinalRecon is a modular Python framework covering headers, WHOIS, SSL, DNS, subdomains, crawling, directories, port scanning, and Wayback Machine in one tool. Flags combined freely to run only needed modules. --full runs everything. API keys unlock Shodan, VirusTotal for deeper enumeration.

=== OUTPUT ===
Results auto-exported to default directory (or custom -cd path). JSON format enables downstream processing. First-pass automation to surface broad landscape — then triage interesting findings manually.

=== CHAINING ===
FinalRecon first pass → interesting subdomains → targeted DNS analysis → interesting headers → fingerprinting → interesting directories → fuzz/crawl.

=== TUNING ===
-w: custom wordlist for directory enum. -dt: thread count for dirs. -pt: thread count for port scan. Trade speed vs stealth based on assessment type.
